valores.label: Dittman Research poll, late Sept. 1982: would probably vote for the move

fonte: Anchorage Daily News (poll); Alaska Division of Elections (result)
legenda: Poll of 527 respondents (Dittman Research, late September 1982) versus the official result.
texto_para_tela: POLL (LATE SEPT.): 52% FOR · 45% AGAINST → RESULT (NOV. 2): 102,083 NO · 91,049 YES
credito_tela: Source: Anchorage Daily News, 2026; Alaska Division of Elections, 1982
nota: A pesquisa em si (Dittman Research; a coluna cita ADN, 9/10/1982, A-1 e A-12) não foi aberta: o número é de fonte secundária, com a pesquisa nomeada, como a voz faz.
divergencia_com_narracao_ou_fontes: Resultado: a lista-resumo H29 dá 91,249 para o sim; o boletim oficial por distrito dá 91,049 (lido hoje na imagem). A tela usa o boletim (decisão do roteiro-editor.md). Com os dois, o não fica em 'nearly 53 percent' (52,86 % e 52,80 %).
narracao: A Dittman Research poll in late September had the move ahead, 52 percent to 45. In November 1982, the no side won, with nearly 53 percent.

conferencia.localizador: parágrafo 'To many in Alaska, on both sides of the issue'
conferencia.prova: "In late September 1982, Dittman Research of Anchorage conducted a statewide poll… Of the 527 respondents, 52% said they would probably vote in favor of the move versus 45% opposed. Only 3% were undecided"

fontes.documento: David Reamer, 'One man's pork is another man's pigskin: The 1982 question of whether Alaska should move the capital or buy the NFL' (Histories of Alaska, published Feb. 9, 2026)
